arguments.sql:
SELECT 'post_after_close' k, h."JRNL_NO"::text a, h."POST_DT"::text b, p."CLOSE_DT"::text c, h."SRC_CD" d, h."MEMO" e FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p USING("PRD_ID") WHERE p."CLOSE_DT" IS NOT NULL AND h."POST_DT">p."CLOSE_DT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'gl_journals', h."JRNL_NO"::text, h."PRD_ID"::text, h."POST_DT"::text, h."SRC_REF", h."MEMO" FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."SRC_CD"='GL' AND h."JRNL_NO" NOT IN (2463,2474) AND h."JRNL_NO" NOT IN (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "MEMO"='Manual accrual')
UNION ALL SELECT 'acct5900', l."JRNL_NO"::text, l."DR_AMT"::text, l."CR_AMT"::text, h."POST_DT"::text, h."MEMO" FROM "GLJRNL" l JOIN "GLJRNH" h USING("JRNL_NO") WHERE l."ACCT_CD" LIKE '5900%'
UNION ALL SELECT 'cm_jrnl', h."JRNL_NO"::text, h."POST_DT"::text, h."PRD_ID"::text, h."MEMO", (SELECT string_agg(l."ACCT_CD"||':'||l."DR_AMT"||'/'||l."CR_AMT", ' | ') FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO") FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=2475
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_jrnl_sample', h."JRNL_NO"::text, h."SRC_REF", h."MEMO", (SELECT string_agg(l."ACCT_CD"||':'||l."DR_AMT"||'/'||l."CR_AMT", ' | ') FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO"), '' FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."SRC_REF" IN ('PAY-24','PAY-30')
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_ref_match', count(*)::text, '', '', '', '' FROM "APPAYM" p JOIN "GLJRNH" h ON h."SRC_REF"='PAY-'||p."PAY_ID"
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_dt_vs_post', count(*)::text, sum((i."INV_DT"<>h."POST_DT")::int)::text, '', '', '' FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNH" h USING("JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_ref_match', count(*)::text, sum((h."SRC_REF"=i."VEND_CD"||'-'||i."INV_NO")::int)::text, sum((h."SRC_REF"=trim(i."VEND_CD")||'-'||i."INV_NO")::int)::text, min(i."INV_NO"), '' FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNH" h USING("JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'vend_cd_len', length("VEND_CD")::text, count(*)::text, pg_typeof("VEND_CD")::text, '', '' FROM "APINVH" GROUP BY length("VEND_CD"), pg_typeof("VEND_CD")
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_dt_vs_jrnl', count(*)::text, sum((p."PAY_DT"<>h."POST_DT")::int)::text, '', '', '' FROM "APPAYM" p JOIN "GLJRNH" h ON h."SRC_REF"='PAY-'||p."PAY_ID"
